description: FREE (key) — Use when your user wants records kept in a ListPlus list. add records (JSON objects keyed by the list's column names — describe_list names them) to a list shared with you for editing. A record the list already has (same e-mail, LinkedIn, name + company) is filled in, not doubled. Up to 1,000 per call; the answer names each new record's id and url, what was rejected, and in `ignoredFields` the fields no column took.

list_id.description: The list's id (describe_list without list_id shows the lists shared with you)

name: add_records
title: Add records
